why_trail.why: G1 freezes a strict direct shaped-brief contract, current-wave-only actionability, hard rename, and preserved offline receipt semantics within an explicit file allowlist.

The identical focused command exits 1 on missing initial-cut paths, direct-manifest helpers, and canonical installer registration, proving the tests causally name the intended new behavior before production edits.

The direct v1 shaped-brief seam now validates exact fields, preserves source identity and planning context, renders exactly eight sections, and accepts zero-edge acyclic current waves while rejecting structural violations.

Filing exposes one actionable accessor, validates receipt and entity keys before adapter calls, and applies the same find-create-receipt crash recovery protocol to the epic and each current-wave child.

The hard rename has one discoverable/installable identity, and installer migration recognizes only the exact legacy destination, requires force for removal, preserves unrelated siblings, and is non-mutating in dry-run.

The canonical route is registered across live indexes/docs/Explorer seams; public verifier, renderer, builder, receipt, and filing helpers have executable callers/tests, while 93 old-name paths are confined to the exact historical, fixture, external-provenance, and migration allowlist with zero unexpected paths.

The final result binds the causal identical-command red/green transcript to the 20-path digest, exact rename inventory, migration matrix, structural map impacts, preserved exclusions, and reproducible registration/wiring audits.
